prompt:
Dense flat vector knolling illustration, landscape 3:2, a packed top-down flat lay of camping and field gear on a fully transparent background. Match the drawing style of the reference exactly: flat fills, faceted hard-edged geometry, no outlines, no gradients, no painterly shading, no texture; detail comes from many small flat facets, straps, buckles, zips, stitching lines, labels and panels drawn as flat shapes.
Center, large: a pitched A-frame tent seen from the side, wide and low, ridge running horizontally, pale mint canvas with a deep green front panel, a lighter open doorway, stitched seams, guy lines to square stakes on either side; no ground plane under it.
Packed tightly around it in a neat knolling grid, all seen from above, at least twenty-four pieces of gear with small gaps between them: a folded trail map with contour lines, a brass compass, a closed charcoal laptop, a camping lantern, a coiled climbing rope, a field notebook and pencil, a rolled canvas tool roll with wrench and screwdriver, a headlamp, a water bottle, a thermos, a camp stove, a mug, a folding knife, a first-aid pouch, a carabiner cluster, a pair of boots, wool socks, a beanie, a rain shell, a sleeping bag rolled, a sleeping pad rolled, a spork, a matchbox, a whistle, a small radio, trekking poles, a camera, sunglasses, a watch, tent stakes bundled, small scattered pebbles between items.
Palette limited to deep green #006636, moss #417703, pale mint #dff3e4, stone #eceee9, charcoal #3d3f44 and white; a few pale mint highlights. No text, no letters, no logos, no people, no background, no frame, no watermark. Genuine transparent alpha around every object.
